question: What explains a roughly 26-minute Pages run, and does evidence justify the test cost?

ordinaryFastAssertions.caveat: Sum of Node subtest wall durations; overlapping files, not CPU seconds or an additive share of full-run wall time.

largestMeasuredIndividualTest.name: legacy full-score migration classifies harmless SVG serialization separately from changed ink
largestMeasuredIndividualTest.coverage: Generated eight-record history in disposable checkouts; four live duration variants; all page ink parity; serialization-only acceptance; changed-ink refusal; original-byte preservation. No operator private history read.

confirmedRedundantWork.scope: Diagnostic only: literal six-page migration helper on the current Brahms score, followed by existing settled-layout APIs. No repository source changes; warm-order timing is illustrative, solve counts and exact SVG equality are the evidence.

focusedProfile.test: the prepared studio is deterministic across fresh generations
focusedProfile.scope: Two complete fresh generations in one existing test; --cpu-prof enabled; no repository source edits
focusedProfile.caveat: Inclusive shares overlap. Local profiled timing is not a controlled before/after comparison with GitHub or an attribution of the entire suite. Profile samples do not supply individual source-score phase durations.

scheduling.caveat: Current code explicitly isolates these files; available documentation does not establish that a higher concurrency value is safe or faster. This profile alone reached about 1 GiB RSS.

finding: Full-score comparisons and refusal/preservation coverage are meaningful. A 26-minute runtime is not established as necessary: exact repeated layout work is directly demonstrated. Optimize repeated calculation and measure the retained coverage before removing tests or changing release gates.
limits: Prior GitHub run is the previous source head; active No14 publication changes the workload.
Only one existing current-head test was profiled; no local full-suite rerun.
No test deletion, gate/configuration change, source optimization or private operator state access.
Maximum safe concurrency, full-suite CPU/heap critical path and net end-to-end improvement remain unmeasured.
